title: What age group do you cater to for occupational therapy?
metaTitle: Occupational Therapy Age Group | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Pinnacle Blooms provides professionally designed Occupational Therapy services tailored to kids between the ages of 1 and 7. Each child is unique, we create personalized programs to meet individual needs.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms, our Occupational Therapy services are accessible to kids in the age bracket of 1 to 7 years. We believe that every child is unique. Therefore, our fantastic team of therapists creates personalized therapy programs to match each child's distinct needs, helping them achieve their full potential.
